positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-	Built user workflow in Angular and API in C# for an analysis automation that reduced the labor required to produce specific client deliverables by around 100 hours.
-	Revamped a user management and permissions system reducing analyst workload by several hours during client kickoffs and throughout the contract lifecycle.
-	Collaborated on a product wide upgrade from .Net Framework 4.8 to .Net Core 8 that resulted in zero downtime or system outages through extensive functional and unit testing.
-	Developed frontend analyst workstream and server-side processing that combined multiple separate inefficient client licensing processes into a single streamlined workflow.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-	Overhauled the main product dashboard/landing page significantly improving the initial user experience as well as providing important metrics and visualizations via new charts created with ChartJs.
-	Assisted on a product wide upgrade from AngularJS 1.5 to Angular 16 and ensured maximum uptime and quality through significant functional testing.

positions.title: Computer Lab Assistant
positions.description:
Troubleshooted general PC and printer issues
Processed and documented user issues and resolutions in Jira
Provided technical support for common desktop and web applications as well 
as proprietary software
